turns.content: Can you tell me about ibuprofen?
Ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin) is an NSAID used for pain relief, fever reduction, and inflammation. Common OTC doses are 200-400 mg every 4-6 hours.
Common side effects include stomach upset, nausea, and heartburn. Serious but rare effects include GI bleeding and kidney impairment with prolonged use.
Should I take it with food?
Yes, take ibuprofen with food or milk to reduce stomach irritation.
And what is the maximum I can take per day?
The OTC maximum is 1,200 mg per day. Do not exceed this limit without physician guidance.
